legalBasis: Approved customer termination and deletion instruction after contract and legal review.

retentionDecisions.auditEvidence: The encrypted deletion evidence archive is retained for the approved accountability period.
retentionDecisions.backups: Every backup generation containing tenant data expires no later than backupExpiresAt.
retentionDecisions.billing: Required accounting evidence remains only in the approved external accounting system.
retentionDecisions.certificates: Certificate evidence was transferred in the customer export and approved for primary deletion.
retentionDecisions.learningRecords: Learning records were transferred in the customer export and approved for primary deletion.
